name: 1.22.0-beta.20
notes: Find variants by hand: a layer can now be see-through (for a shadow, a blush or a glow). Choose “See-through” before making it: it becomes one colour laid over what is under it, as strong at each point as the version shows, so it also looks right over other things (a shadow over a hat it never fell on in that version). Soft edges are followed until they fade out.
Each layer can be switched between solid and see-through afterwards; for see-through layers the colour is found for you, and can be changed (with how well it fits shown).
Layers that only fit together (a hat with a shadow over it) are now found in a version together.
